why: SPEC E2-C 9.1. v1 of that spec left its thresholds in prose -- 'each at least once', 'cell-by-cell identical', 'no continuous growth', 'required ODT' -- for a validator written after the results existed to interpret. E2-B has already been bitten by that order once, when an analyzer quietly replaced a pre-registered criterion and the arm passed. This file is the criteria, written before the first browser round, and it is what tools/validate_e2_c.py reads.

comparisonProjection.why: 'The two browsers agree cell by cell' is meaningless until it says WHICH fields agree. Timings never match; codes, routes and document effects must.

decisionPolicy.why: A manifest-declared action or gesture that fails cannot be narrowed without editing the frozen manifest, and editing it detaches E2-B's 132 runs. So there is no PARTIAL for contract cells -- only for what was declared outside the contract before the round started.

validatorSelfTest.why: SPEC E2-C 9.1. Testing that the validator notices a changed hash is far weaker than the verdict it issues; every predicate that can turn the verdict has to be shown to go red.
mustGoRedWhenMutated: shell bundle digest recomputed from disk

execution.note: Frozen before D0. Any edit after the first browser round is a change to the criteria and must be recorded in SPEC E2-C's revision table with the reason.
